list.name: app
list.label: app
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT app FROM market.metrics ORDER BY app
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT app FROM market.metrics ORDER BY app

panels.title: Messages / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['kind']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM market.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'messages' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Counter deltas: each interval's increase, summed across cells and divided by the bucket's seconds.

panels.title: Spread (bps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['instrument'] AS instrument, avg(value) AS bps FROM market.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'spread_bps' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.description: A gauge: the last value set before each interval ended.

panels.title: Venue to us, p50 / p99 (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['kind']) AS series, quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(le, c) / 1e6 AS p50, quantileExactWeighted(0.99)(le, c) / 1e6 AS p99 FROM market.metrics_histogram ARRAY JOIN buckets.le AS le, buckets.count AS c WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'venue_to_local_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Buckets merged across intervals, so percentiles are exact to 3.1%. Zero when the venue's clock is ahead of ours (see Clamped).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, app, quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(le, c) / 1e3 AS p50, quantileExactWeighted(0.99)(le, c) / 1e3 AS p99, quantileExactWeighted(0.999)(le, c) / 1e3 AS p999 FROM market.metrics_histogram ARRAY JOIN buckets.le AS le, buckets.count AS c WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'record_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, app ORDER BY time

panels.title: record() latency distribution (last interval)

targets.rawSql: SELECT le AS upper_ns, sum(c) AS count FROM market.metrics_histogram ARRAY JOIN buckets.le AS le, buckets.count AS c WHERE name = 'record_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) AND ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM market.metrics_histogram WHERE name = 'record_ns') GROUP BY le ORDER BY le

panels.description: Each bucket's count: its upper bound in ns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['reason']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM market.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'persist_dropped' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Clamped trace stages / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['trace'], ' ', labels['stage']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM market.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_clamped' AND labels['stage'] != 'total' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stages that ended before they began: the venue's clock is ahead of ours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, kind, app, pod, host, labels, argMax(value, ts) AS last FROM market.metrics WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE GROUP BY name, kind, app, pod, host, labels ORDER BY name, app
